📌 One person, one need, one problem difficulty D. Everything below is a choice about composition, not about effort or goodwill.
📌 The standard design. Five links, each a place the person can be lost.
📌 A link. It can only hold or break — it cannot rescue a break upstream of it.
📌 A link. It can only hold or break — it cannot rescue a break upstream of it.

📌 Reached only if all five links hold.

📌 Adding a care coordinator makes it six links: −1.79. The coordinator is another link. This is why coordination roles so often fail to fix a pathway — they lengthen the thing they were hired to strengthen.
📌 The same need, composed as a Pack. No hand-offs, no required agreement.
📌 Tries something the others are not trying. If it fails, the Pack has lost nothing.

📌 Reached if ANY of the eight lands. Independent of how hard the problem is.
📌 A 3.7 logit swing over the chain, from the same eight people and the same problem. Eight is not arbitrary: to cover a problem 2 logits above the group's mean ability you need ln N > 2, so N ≥ 8.
